answer: A newcomer earns their place at the wharf with a pearl. They lock a $6 bond and take one pearl from the wharf book; each task adds a mark. Within a day a wanderer arrives unannounced, reads the marks, and asks to see the newest one. Matching marks return the bond; a forged mark or a task never done burns the bond and strikes the pearl. One hundred fakes would burn $600 and need one hundred pearls.
